title: Converting Units within the SI and between Measurement Systems
seo_title: Grade 7 Converting Units Worksheets with Answers (MATATAG Math 7)
standard_text: Convert units of measure within the International System of Units (SI) and across different systems of measure.
meta_desc: Free Grade 7 unit conversion worksheets for the DepEd MATATAG curriculum: metric (SI) units and converting between metric and English units of length, mass and capacity. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Bigger to smaller unit: multiply. Smaller to bigger: divide.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • SI (metric) prefixes: kilo = 1,000, centi = 1100, milli = 11,000. 1 km = 1,000 m, 1 m = 100 cm, 1 kg = 1,000 g, 1 L = 1,000 mL.
  • Bigger unit to smaller unit: multiply. Smaller to bigger: divide.
  • English units still used in the Philippines: 1 inch = 2.54 cm, 1 foot = 12 inches ≈ 30.48 cm, 1 mile ≈ 1.61 km, 1 pound ≈ 0.454 kg, 1 gallon ≈ 3.79 L.
  • Write the factor so the old unit cancels: 5 ft × 30.48 cm1 ft.

Examples

Example

A TV screen of 32 inches

32 × 2.54

Answer: 81.28 cm

Example

3.5 kg

3.5 × 1,000

Answer: 3,500 g

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Multiplying to a bigger unitcm to m: divide by 100.
100 for every unitOnly m–cm uses 100 in length; kilo and milli use 1,000.
Factor upside downThe old unit must cancel.
